notes.title: CIPHER-8 is out!
notes.notes:
Hi! I'm super excited to let you know my brain-twisting arcade puzzler [b]CIPHER-8[/b] is available right now and it's 100% [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2552900/CIPHER8/]FREE on Steam[/url]! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532438/3a4413bd701ae7b13a31acb7a9f5c62784d6a34c.gif[/img]

[b]Why make it free you might ask?[/b] Well, this release is primarily a love letter to [b]PICO-8[/b], a virtual fantasy console that has been around for 8 years and fostered an entire ecosystem of cozy creativity. Seriously, check out some of the thousands of fun games available for it! ❤️

Now, CIPHER-8 is a challenging game, so maybe try starting in the non-timed [b]puzzle mode[/b] at first. Once you get the hang of it, you may catch yourself spotting more and more unexpected opportunities and [b]blitz mode[/b] may soon feel like you're some half-automated wizard! 🤯

I hope you have a tiny bit of fun with my little game. If you do, [b]consider leaving a review[/b] (and maybe take a peek at my next "bigger" title, a billiard roguelike called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2311990/Rack_and_Slay/]Rack and Slay[/url])! :)

All the best,
Fabian
